newsitem.title: UK: Rail watchdog says Railtrack can do better.
newsitem.headline: Rail watchdog says Railtrack can do better.

text.p: UK Rail Regulator John Swift told Railtrack Plc on Thursday it still had a "long way to go" despite showing signs of improvement in the last year.

The verdict on the UK rail infrastructure giant came in Swift's annual review of the year in which he warned Railtrack: "I have intervened and will continue to do so where I see evidence of Railtrack seeking to obtain disproportionate profit from an investment or refusing to undertake investments without reasonable justification."
